long_description:
## What it is

Venato Bianco (model GP00215) is a glazed vitrified tile from Kajaria's 600 x 1200 mm range. It is a dry-pressed porcelain body carrying a digitally printed white marble design under a nano-polished glaze, sold in a rectified 600 x 1200 mm module, 9 mm thick.

## What it's for

Kajaria lists it for both floor and wall use, which is how the 2 x 4 ft format is normally specified in Andhra Pradesh and Telangana: a continuous polished floor through living, dining and bedroom areas, with the same tile carried up a feature wall so the veining runs uninterrupted. Its PEI IV abrasion class and vitrified body suit domestic traffic and light-commercial interiors such as showrooms and offices. With an R9 slip class and a polished surface it is an indoor, dry-area tile - not a balcony, terrace or open-parking tile.

## Key specifications

The body is a Group BIa vitrified porcelain with water absorption at or below 0.5%, which is what keeps a polished large-format tile dimensionally stable and stain-tolerant. Breaking strength is taken at 1300 N with a modulus of rupture of 35 N/mm², both to IS 15622 and the ISO 10545 test series, and surface hardness is around MOHS 6. Dimensional tolerance is held to 0.6%, so the rectified edges close up on a 2 mm joint. Stain resistance is Class 5 and the tile is frost resistant and resistant to thermal shock.

## Application and installation notes

Fix thin-bed over a levelled, fully cured screed using polymer-modified adhesive - Kajaria recommends Gresbond VX-1 or VX-2 internally and EX-5 externally. Back-butter each tile so there are no voids under a 1200 mm span, keep joints at 2 mm, and check the shade batch on the box before laying, since shade variation is V2.

## What's in the box

One box holds 2 tiles, covering 1.44 m² (about 15.5 sqft), and weighs about 31 kg. Sold by the box under HSN 6907 at 18% GST.
